descriptor.name: Ruru: abnormal environment
descriptor.description: Ruru's AbnormalEnvironment: Xposed hooks in the process, a secondary user profile, marker files of hiding tools, and su, busybox and magisk in ten directories.

evidenceUnits.title: xposed-detector status
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Xposed hooks in the host process
evidenceUnits.proposition: An Xposed environment is present in the process
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: xposed-detector get_xposed_status() from Ruru's native library
evidenceUnits.availability: Always answers; the library inspects its own process
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Loading the library clears hooks it recognises; a negative is concealable

evidenceUnits.title: Files directory owner
evidenceUnits.observedObject: The user the host's files directory belongs to
evidenceUnits.proposition: The host runs in a secondary user or work profile
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A secondary profile is not tampering; Ruru reports it as suspicious

evidenceUnits.title: Hiding-tool marker files
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Seven files left by Hide My Applist (old), XPrivacyLua, TWRP, Xposed Edge, Riru Clipboard and PrivacySpace
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: raw faccessat (libc access/stat/open(O_PATH) after SIGSYS), as detectFile
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers for a path on ENOENT or ENOTDIR, with /system/bin/sh visible through the same call
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The host app's mount namespace and SELinux domain
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Most markers lie under /data/system or /data/misc, which apps cannot search; a negative is concealable

evidenceUnits.title: su, busybox and magisk files
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Files named su, busybox or magisk in Ruru's ten directories
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: raw faccessat (libc access/stat/open(O_PATH) after SIGSYS), as detectFile
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers for a path on ENOENT or ENOTDIR, with /system/bin/sh visible through the same call
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The host app's mount namespace and SELinux domain
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Ruru checks "/cache" + name (no slash); a negative is concealable

evidenceUnits.availability: Answers only when the listing contains the host and the android package
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: system_server's package filtering for the host app
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A renamed or repackaged app is not seen; a negative is concealable

descriptor.name: Ruru: libc file detection
descriptor.description: Ruru's FileDetection(useSyscall = false): whether a data directory of any basic package is visible.

evidenceUnits.title: App data paths
evidenceUnits.observedObject: /data/data, /data/user_de/0, /data/misc/profiles/ref and Android/{data,media,obb} directories of the basic packages
evidenceUnits.proposition: A data directory of a listed package exists
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: access(F_OK), stat and fstat(open(O_PATH)) on six data paths per package
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers for a path family only when com.android.settings' directory in that family is visible through the same call (app data isolation hides it otherwise)
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The host app's mount namespace, SELinux domain and storage view
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A leftover directory does not show an installed app; a negative is concealable

descriptor.name: Ruru: Xposed modules
descriptor.description: Ruru's XposedModules(lspatch = false) over every app with a MAIN activity.

evidenceUnits.title: Launcher apps
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Xposed module metadata and META-INF/xposed/module.prop in launcher apps
evidenceUnits.proposition: A launcher app is an Xposed module
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: queryIntentActivities(ACTION_MAIN, GET_META_DATA), then each app's metadata and APK
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers for an app whose APK and metadata could be read, when the host itself is listed
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: system_server's package filtering for the host app
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A module without a MAIN activity is never listed; a negative is concealable

descriptor.name: Ruru: repackaged Magisk app
descriptor.description: Ruru's MagiskApp compares every launcher app's size, components and permissions with the Magisk stub APK shipped in its assets.

evidenceUnits.title: Stub-shaped launcher apps
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Non-system launcher apps whose size and components match the Magisk stub
evidenceUnits.proposition: A launcher app is a repackaged Magisk app
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: queryIntentActivities(ACTION_MAIN) and getPackageInfo per app, compared with getPackageArchiveInfo(assets/stub.apk)
evidenceUnits.availability: Answers only when the stub reference parses and the host is listed; an app whose comparison throws is not answered
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: system_server's package filtering for the host app
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Upstream swallows every per-app exception, including a missing stub; a negative is concealable
